title: Aligned Delta-Triplane Transformers as Occupancy World Models
abstract: arXiv:2503.07338v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Occupancy World Models (OWMs) aim to predict future 3D occupancy scenes from historical observations and future ego motions, providing a useful world simulation tool for autonomous driving. Existing methods usually rely on large networks to implicitly align multi-frame historical states and predict future occupancy in a full-state manner, which is costly and redundant because most scene regions remain unchanged over short time intervals. In this paper, we propose Aligned Delta-Triplane Transformer (ADTT), a compact 4D OWM that explicitly aligns historical triplanes with ego-motion compensation and predicts only future scene changes. Based on the aligned triplane prior, a query-conditioned Transformer predicts residual changes, where ego-motion queries guide controllable future motion and learnable external queries capture scene changes beyond ego motion. translated_title: 作为占据世界模型的对齐增量三平面Transformer
translated_abstract: 占据世界模型旨在从历史观测和未来自车运动预测未来3D占据场景，为自动驾驶提供有用的世界仿真工具。现有方法通常依赖大型网络隐式对齐多帧历史状态，并以全状态方式预测未来占据，这既昂贵又冗余，因为在短时间间隔内大多数场景区域保持不变。在本文中，我们提出了对齐增量三平面Transformer（ADTT），这是一个紧凑的4D占据世界模型，它通过自车运动补偿显式对齐历史三平面，并仅预测未来场景的变化。基于对齐的三平面先验，一个查询条件Transformer预测残差变化，其中自车运动查询引导可控的未来运动，可学习的外部查询捕捉自车运动之外的场景变化。预测的变化被添加到对齐的先验上，并解码为未来占据场景。
tldr: 提出对齐增量三平面Transformer（ADTT），通过自车运动补偿显式对齐历史三平面并仅预测场景残差变化，构建了紧凑高效的4D占据世界模型用于自动驾驶仿真。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Aligned Delta-Triplane Transformer (ADTT), a compact 4D occupancy world model that explicitly aligns historical triplanes with ego-motion compensation and predicts only residual scene changes, enabling efficient world simulation for autonomous driving.
